_meta.purpose: Canonical, verified-working Zenodo REST API request/response schema for the QNFO publication pipeline. Read this BEFORE constructing any Zenodo API call to prevent repeated schema-guessing failures documented in incident_log.
incident_log: 2026-07-21: ~15 tool calls wasted diagnosing 403 as 'token dead/read-only' when actual cause was a hand-transcribed truncated token. See scripts/zenodo-token-check.py.

2026-07-25 (adelic-cross-domain v3.2 newversion): metadata.resource_type accepted as a bare STRING ('publication') on PUT, but REJECTED as an OBJECT ({type, subtype}) with error 'Not a valid string' on a NEW-VERSION DRAFT's metadata PUT. Working fix was top-level upload_type + publication_type STRING fields instead of a nested resource_type object. ALWAYS GET the current draft metadata first and match its existing field shape before PUTting -- do not assume schema.

2026-07-25: actions/publish failed with 'Missing data for required field: resource_type' even though a prior metadata PUT with resource_type as a string returned HTTP 200 -- the value was silently NOT persisted server-side. Workaround: use upload_type/publication_type string pair (verified to persist and allow publish to succeed).

auth.token_storage_rule: NEVER hardcode value. Read live from os.environ.get('ZENODO_TOKEN') or $env:ZENODO_TOKEN. NEVER hand-copy a truncated terminal display (see qnfo-agent KIF-10).

create_new_deposit.note: Empty JSON body creates an empty draft. Response contains id (deposit id), links.bucket (files upload URL), links.html (draft URL).

create_new_version.note: existing_deposit_id MUST be the LATEST version deposit id, verified via a GET first (see version_chain_check). Response contains links.latest_draft -- extract the new draft id from the URL's last path segment.
create_new_version.gotcha: Calling this on a stale (non-latest) deposit id returns HTTP 403.

upload_file.note: CRITICAL: Content-Type MUST be application/octet-stream. Using application/pdf or omitting causes SILENT FAILURE (HTTP 200 but file not actually stored) or HTTP 415. Root cause of a WBS v3.2 deposition corruption incident (9 markers stuck PENDING).
upload_file.verify: GET https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/{deposit_id}/files afterwards -- confirm filesize matches local file byte count.

delete_file.note: Use to remove stale files auto-copied by actions/newversion before uploading replacements.

get_draft_metadata.note: ALWAYS run BEFORE any metadata PUT to see the exact current field shape (especially resource_type / upload_type). Match existing shape rather than assuming a schema.

metadata.title: string, required
metadata.upload_type: string, required -- one of: publication, dataset, software, poster, presentation, image, video, lesson, physicalobject, other
metadata.publication_type: string, required IF upload_type=publication -- one of: annotationcollection, book, section, conferencepaper, datamanagementplan, article, patent, preprint, deliverable, milestone, proposal, report, softwaredocumentation, taxonomictreatment, technicalnote, thesis, workingpaper, other
metadata.access_right: string, required -- one of: open, embargoed, restricted, closed
metadata.license: string, required if access_right=open -- SPDX id e.g. CC-BY-4.0
metadata.keywords: ARRAY of strings, not a comma-joined string -- omit entirely if unsure to avoid 400s

body_schema_variant_B_newversion_draft_s._comment: VERIFIED WORKING 2026-07-25 for a draft created via actions/newversion when variant A's nested resource_type/publication_type object was rejected with 'Not a valid string'.

metadata.title: string
metadata.related_identifiers: same array shape as variant A

response_error_signatures.missing_resource_type_on_publish: HTTP 400 metadata.resource_type Missing data for required field -- occurs on actions/publish even though the metadata PUT returned 200. Means the PUT value was NOT persisted -- re-GET the draft to confirm before assuming success.
response_error_signatures.invalid_resource_type_object: HTTP 400 metadata.resource_type Not a valid string -- occurs when resource_type is a nested object on certain newversion drafts. Fall back to variant B (upload_type + publication_type top-level strings).

publish.pre_check: GET the draft metadata FIRST and confirm upload_type/publication_type (or resource_type) is non-empty before calling publish -- a metadata PUT returning 200 is NOT sufficient evidence the field persisted.

urls: https://zenodo.org/api/records/{id}  (expect HTTP 200, JSON with doi and related_identifiers populated)
verify_published.rule: NEVER report published from the actions/publish response alone. Independently re-query one of the above URLs in the SAME turn before claiming success (Anti-Phantom Gate).

version_chain_check.purpose: Prevent calling actions/newversion on a stale deposit id (HTTP 403)
steps: 2. If this fails or state is not latest, look up current latest via GET https://zenodo.org/api/records/?q=conceptdoi:"{concept_doi}"
3. Track state in project-local .zenodo_versions.json: {concept_doi, latest_deposit_id, versions:[{doi, deposit_id, tag, published_at}]}

provenance_bundle_gate.rule: PROVENANCE-BUNDLE.zip MUST exist and contain paper.md + paper.pdf BEFORE upload begins. Verify with a zipfile.namelist() check.
